Through Void Chart, you can customize your Netherrealm stage experience to a certain extent.
There are dozens of different Talent Constellations in the Void Chart.
By spending Star Talents and Prime Star Talents, you can activate any Talent Node within a Talent Constellation.
Affixes on activated Talent Nodes will be added to Netherrealm stages.
Star Talents are primarily obtained by defeating unique Plane Watchers.
A small number of Star Talents must be obtained through the Path of Progression.
Prime Star Talents are obtained by defeating Travelers.
